description:
Pick a club and start on the streets — that is where it is settled.

Ultras Online is a multiplayer game about football supporter culture. You

arrive as nobody, fight on your district for reputation, earn on the job

board, put together some kit, and one day join a firm that runs its city.

THE DISTRICT

The first place that tests you. Opponents are live players and locals: bare

fists, skulls for reputation, ranks for skulls. Lose and you drop coupons; win

and you take theirs.

THE STADIUM

A season of 448 fixtures: eight leagues of eight clubs, fourteen rounds,

kickoffs on Tuesdays and Saturdays. Buy a ticket and you stand in the stand and

fight for your club yourself. Sides are topped up until neither is outnumbered,

every hit draws a reply, and no match ends level. Hit the same supporter twice

inside three seconds and the second one lands harder.

THE WASTELAND

Firm against firm. Twenty-four hours to put the other roster down, up to three

targets at once, rage instead of ammunition. A win takes the loser's flag and a

place in the table.

YOUR FIRM

Up to thirty people, a treasury, a charter, a slogan and your own emblem. Join

requests, tasks, events, awards, and a month of your battle history. When an

owner walks out the deputy inherits the chair rather than nobody.

YOUR FIGHTER

Strength, endurance, agility, charisma. Clothing, weapons, amulets. Talismans

that fire on their own: the Neo figure slips a punch, the glove doubles the

damage, the spring sends it back, the mask hands your rage back. Tattoos,

charges and provisions change how a fight ends, not just a number on a profile.

ALSO

— Boards: club elite, best of the best, best at your level, records, the

district's threat, the day's grafters, the league table

— Global chat, club pub, firm board and personal mail

— A nightly paper with the day's results

— Table football and a lottery

— English, Russian and Ukrainian

The server decides everything: damage, rewards, results. Nothing is faked.

Free to play. Clubs, crests and names are invented.

description:
Last Day on Earth: Survival places you in a hostile world where supplies are limited and every trip outside your shelter carries risk. You begin with very little and gradually work toward safer equipment, stronger defenses, and access to harder areas. The game focuses on planning what to take, what to leave behind, and when to return home. Before installing the Last Day on Earth: Survival APK, players should expect resource gathering, combat, and the possibility of losing carried items in dangerous zones.


Survival features

Gather materials and build a shelter

Last Day on Earth: Survival lets you collect wood, stone, metal, food, and other supplies from the wasteland. You can use these materials to create tools, weapons, armor, medicine, storage, workbenches, traps, and stronger walls. As your shelter grows, it becomes a place to prepare before entering more dangerous locations.

Explore locations with different risks

You can visit forests, suburbs, farms, military zones, toxic areas, ports, police stations, and underground bunkers. Each area may contain useful components, but enemies and hazards can make it difficult to leave safely. Because inventory space is limited, players need to decide which supplies are worth carrying back to base.

Fight zombies with prepared equipment

Last Day on Earth: Survival includes melee weapons, firearms, and explosives for fighting zombies, hordes, and bosses. Weapon modifications can change power, fire rate, range, and other effects. Before entering a bunker or a high danger zone, it helps to bring healing items, spare weapons, and enough room for important loot.

Use pets and transport

Huskies and shepherds can help during combat and carry loot on expeditions. Later, players can assemble transport such as the Chopper, ATV, and motorboat to reach more remote places. These vehicles also support progression by opening access to areas with different resources.

Choose solo or social activities

You can progress through crafting, exploration, base upgrades, and combat without joining a clan. However, clans offer options for cooperation and trading, while the Crater includes competitive encounters with other survivors. This gives players a choice between independent survival and activities involving other players.


Risk, inventory loss, and PvP

Last Day on Earth: Survival uses a risk versus reward loop. Rare materials are often found in locations where zombies, bosses, or other threats can stop an expedition. Dying in hazardous areas or during PvP can result in lost inventory, so players should avoid taking every valuable item at once and keep essential supplies at base when possible.

Med kits, bandages, spare armor, and a planned route back can reduce the impact of a failed run. PvP is connected to competitive activities such as the Crater, while core crafting and exploration do not require team play. Players who prefer a solo focused experience can concentrate on shelter upgrades and resource collection before trying social modes.


When restore ads do not register

If a restore ad does not work after viewing it, first check that the phone has a stable internet connection. Closing background apps can also help if the game is not loading ad rewards correctly. If the problem continues, contact the developer’s support team with details about the missing reward and the event where it occurred.


How to play Last Day on Earth: Survival

Last Day on Earth: Survival starts with basic gathering and gradually introduces harder zones, stronger enemies, and larger construction goals. Players using the Last Day on Earth: Survival latest version can follow the same core cycle of preparing at base, collecting supplies, and returning before resources are lost.

description:
The escape game "Heliport Survival" is a highly exciting FPS (first-person perspective) game in which the player is trapped in a heliport filled with zombies and must escape by eliminating them. The player picks up an incineration gun and eliminates the zombies that appear around the heliport one after another. The player must face the looming threat and survive with accurate shooting and smooth movements. However, as the stage progresses, the number of zombies continues to increase and zombies are everywhere.

Players must face waves of enemies, use the flames of their incineration guns, and try to escape in order to survive. The game is highly immersive, making players feel as if they are in a real battlefield. The voices of the zombies, which increase with each stage, suggest the looming threat.

It offers an innovative survival horror-like experience that utilizes AR (Augmented Reality) technology to progress through the game based on the player's current location. One of the features of this game is that the difficulty level at the end changes depending on the specifications of the smartphone. If the specifications of the smartphone are low, the load in the game increases and the operation becomes slow, so the player needs more skill and concentration.

The game progresses with the player's current location as the background. A realistic environment is reproduced around the heliport using AR, and the player faces the threat of approaching zombies. The player operates an incineration gun and aims to escape from 30 difficult stages while defeating the surrounding zombies.

To make your gameplay more realistic and immersive, we strongly recommend using headphones. This is because headphones allow you to hear the in-game sound effects more clearly and make it easier to determine the enemy's location from the zombie's voice. By focusing on the sounds around you, you can take more precise actions and understand the situation in the game more easily.

By wearing headphones, players can hear the sounds of helicopters overhead and the voices of zombies in the game realistically right in their ears, allowing them to pinpoint the direction of the approaching threat. This allows players to skillfully control the incineration gun and more accurately deal with the approaching zombie threat.

Therefore, using headphones increases the tension and realism of the game. Players are immersed in a realistic situation and feel the fear caused by the creepy voices of the zombies around them. This immersive experience draws players into the game world and provides a true survival experience.

In the game, cockroaches will come from all directions into the player's view. The player simply uses the slipper in hand to eliminate them one by one. The game has a time limit of 30 seconds.

When the time is up, the game will automatically score your performance. If you eliminate fewer than 80 cockroaches, the performance is considered poor. Eliminating 80 to 120 cockroaches is average, and eliminating more than 120 cockroaches is excellent.

Good luck! Let's all work together to eliminate pests and maintain a healthy environment at home!

description:
Tomb Raider Reloaded suits players who want short, replayable runs with clear goals and steady progression. Each session fits into a busy day, while longer play stretches allow deeper gear upgrades and tougher challenges. The presentation respects longtime fans without asking for background knowledge, so new players can jump in easily. For those looking to try it on Android, Tomb Raider Reloaded APK offers a straightforward way to experience Lara Croft in a mobile friendly format.


Tomb Raider Reloaded features

Procedurally generated tomb runs

Every run presents new room layouts, hazards, and enemy mixes to keep play sessions varied. You tackle chambers one by one, make choices on the fly, and adapt to different patterns. Because layouts reshuffle each time, learning and improving is part of the loop, which naturally extends replay value over many sessions.

Signature Lara Croft combat and foes

Tomb Raider Reloaded keeps the focus on agile gunplay with the series’ trademark twin pistols. You face wolves, snakes, golems, elemental threats, and a towering T Rex during set encounters. Combat pacing balances movement, timing, and positioning, so you read tells and react to different attack types while managing space in each room.

Traps, puzzles, and varied locations

Rooms mix environmental traps and simple puzzle elements across underground tombs, mountain caves, jungle paths, waterfalls, temples, and dungeon spaces. Movement timing matters as much as shooting, since hazards punish rushing. This blend of navigation and threat management creates a steady rhythm between exploring, avoiding danger, and clearing enemies.

Progression, perks, and crafting

During runs, you choose perks that stack into distinct builds, such as piercing shots, grenades, arch shots, or extra experience gains. Between runs, you collect relics and blueprints to craft and upgrade weapons like a shotgun, dual pistols, an assault rifle, or a mystical staff, plus outfits that affect stats. Progression ties directly to your performance in each session, encouraging experimentation as you refine loadouts over time.

Offline single player and rotating events

Tomb Raider Reloaded focuses on solo play and supports offline sessions for core gameplay. Periodic events, such as special zones, offer time limited challenges that grant gear and materials when cleared. The stylized cartoon visuals and an orchestral score that reworks classic motifs round out the experience with a clear, readable look and familiar musical cues.


Key details about Tomb Raider Reloaded

The game is free to play and includes ads and in app purchases. Content and event availability may rotate over time. Availability and features can vary by region.


How to play Tomb Raider Reloaded on Android

Once you download Tomb Raider Reloaded, the game introduces its core flow through early chapters. Runs are built around short rooms, quick decisions, and steady upgrades, so each session moves at a practical pace.

  1. Launch the game and complete the opening tutorial to learn movement, attack timing, and how rooms progress.
  2. Start a chapter and enter a run, then move cautiously while reading enemy patterns and watching for traps.
  3. When perk choices appear, pick options that fit your current weapon and the threats you are facing.
  4. Collect relics and blueprints during runs, then return to the base when a run ends to manage rewards.
  5. Upgrade weapons and outfits with gathered materials, review event options, and begin your next run with a refined build.


Start playing Tomb Raider Reloaded

Tomb Raider Reloaded delivers mobile friendly tomb runs with roguelike structure, familiar action, and clear progression. To keep up with improvements and fixes, get the Tomb Raider Reloaded latest version when available.

For official information or support, use the following channels.

  • Official website: https://decagames.com/
  • Support email: support@decagames.com

description:
Build a championship esports squad — even while you sleep.

Strike-Command is an idle esports team manager: scout prospects, sign them cheap, train them into legends, and watch your five play tactical bomb-defusal matches round by round.

★ JUMP INTO DEATHMATCH

Send your duelist into an 8-player free-for-all, or your whole lineup into 5v5 Team Deathmatch. Every fight plays out live in front of you, with a mutator of the day that changes the rules. Climb the weekly Frag League with promotion, relegation and prizes for every place. Train perks on Coach Vance's drills board, and level up the 14-day Frag Pass on its free, premium and Elite tracks.

★ REAL TACTICAL MATCHES, LIVE

Every league fixture plays out round by round with animated agents on six maps. Two are rebuilt from scratch: a subway station with a stalled train you can walk through, and an arctic research station around a snowy courtyard. Watch executes, clutches, plants and defuses. Defenders retake with smokes, flashbangs and grenades, and if the fuse runs out the bomb goes off in a full explosion. You get per-agent K/D/A, an MVP and a live play-by-play.

★ FIELD A K9

Every squad runs with a dog. Pick one of twelve breeds, each with a role (Detection, Bomb, Apprehension, Tracker or Guardian) that boosts your team, and watch it work beside your five in every match. Bond with it up to level 10, upgrade your kennel, fuse duplicates into stars and dress it up in the K9 style shop. Every manager gets a free starter pup.

★ TAKE DOWN THE WORLD BOSS

Three times a day a giant boss drops into the arena and every manager attacks it together. Break its phases, climb the boss leaderboard, and earn gear mods for every damage milestone your squad reaches.

★ REAL RIVALS, REAL CLANS

Queue ranked PvP scrims against real managers and climb the divisions from Bronze to Immortal. In the Weekend Tournament nobody gets cut: every entrant plays in a division of similar power, and each division pays its own top 4. Battle through the Weekly Open, or join a clan for weekly clan wars, raid bosses that scale to your clan's strength, and in-clan rankings with weekly prizes for your top donors and fighters.

★ CUPS ARE REAL TOURNAMENTS

There are three cups, each with its own format. The Street Cup is an 8-team knockout. In the Country Cup you play for your flag in a group of four nations. The Champions Cup has best-of-3 finals you can watch. Lift trophies and fill your trophy cabinet, then show it off on your public profile.

★ YOUR SQUAD, ON EVERY DEVICE

Sign in with Google or a CGS ID and your progress saves to the cloud automatically. Switch phones or reinstall and your roster, currency and purchases come with you.

★ GEAR, SETS & MODS

Kit out every agent with helmets, armor, gloves and weapons. Wear 2, 4 or 6 pieces of a set for stacking bonuses, socket mods into rare gear for team-wide boosts, and fuse three mods into the next tier.

★ IDLE INCOME ENGINE

Your org earns cash around the clock — at work, asleep or offline. Sponsors, merch, stickers and streaming deals all scale your income per second.

★ SCOUT, SIGN, TRAIN

Roll the transfer market across eight rarities, from Common up to Ancient and Relic. Every agent has their own face and rolls unique stats, so two equal-rated players play very differently.

★ TALK IT UP

Global, clan and direct chat, with agent stickers, reactions and a full arsenal of weapon emoji.

★ FAIR BY DESIGN

No energy walls, and your first day is free of interstitial ads. Key crates guarantee the top rarity within 40 openings, and a one-time No Ads unlock removes every ad.

★ CLIMB THE LADDER

Win seasons, earn promotions, rebirth through Prestige, collect 67 achievements with painted medals, and push your squad up the global leaderboard.

Free to play with optional in-app purchases.

description:
Join the online 3D horror game and save mini astronauts from the deadly Imposter in various game modes, solo or online multiplayer, with up to 13 players!

In each mode look for the babies and complete tasks to win! Complete a variety of interesting tasks, such as setting up your ship, pointing guns, mopping the floor, and more.

The game has 8 game modes:

- PvE - play with friends against an imposter controlled by the AI.

- PvP - spacemen against the imposter in an online multiplayer mode, players play for the imposter

- Zombie - infection mode, anyone caught by the imposter also becomes an imposter.

- Hide and Seek (Hide n Seek)

- Hunt - find most babies in time

- Rescue - survive a certain amount of time

- Mafia - up to 20 players, among these players is an imposter who looks like other players. But at any moment he can turn into an imposter! Who's the suspect? Who's the most sus?

- Lava - lava rises periodically! Complete objectives and escape to high ground while imps hunt the astronauts.

Discover six unique 3D maps:

1. Space Station 12 - Something terrible has happened, all the crew members are missing, but there are little ones left! You need to save them all, but in addition to the crew member and mini astronauts on the station there is an imposter... Beware of him because he's among us!

2. "Gelios" scientific station, with no one left except the astronauts and mini-astronauts. Krisper the imposter has appeared on the station. Save all the mini astronauts on the station, which is located on a planet covered in sand and lava.

3. Planet IMP-13, where strange things are happening, is the home planet of the [classified] creatures, the astronauts have come to it to explore [classified] and mine [classified]

4. Lab - A scientist accidentally sprayed a minimizing gas in the lab! Now little cosmonauts are being chased by little imposters.

5. Maze - A huge maze on the planet IMP-13, it is unknown who created it and when.

6. City-16 - big interspace city map

7. Carnival - an abandoned amusement park, the imposter is already here!

8. Forest - During operation [classified], a mysterious forest shrouded in fog was discovered. The research team never returned.

- Experience the thrill of tracking down the Impostor in single-player mode, where you'll face off against a Imposter in a high-stakes game of survival. With a variety of challenging objectives and unique gameplay features, our single-player mode is perfect for players looking to hone their skills and strategize against a formidable opponent.

- Ability to play in multiplayer with up to 13 players online in Mafia, PvP, "Hide n Seek" and Zombie modes

- Turn into an imposter in Mafia mode. And don't get caught, because you're a suspect!

- You can play as an Imposter in different modes!

- Use traps in PvP, PvE and Zombie Mode to ward off the imposter

- You can hide in a vent in case of danger!

- It's a scary horror game, with good and creepy 3D graphics and the ability to turn off skrimmers In case the imposter is too scary for you.

- Flashlight hunting mode for the imposter

- Look for suspects in mafia mode. Whoever is the most sus is the traitor!

- You have a flashlight, it will help you see at the scary station.

Build without limits

Roguelike runs and permadeath

  • Evolving zombie bosses introduce new threats as you progress.

Seasonal events and rankings

Then, limited time events add variety with Halloween skins and Christmas themed weapons. Global leaderboards track performance and offer exclusive rewards for high scores. Seasonal content rotates, and the Mech Assemble: Zombie Swarm latest version keeps current events and rankings available.

Community sharing and guild battles

Finally, you can share your designs in the community hub to exchange ideas with other players. Guild wars encourage coordinated strategies and give teams a way to compare results in organized matches.


Get started and test your build

This game focuses on creative assembly and fast survival attempts against mutant zombies. Set your frame, try different weapons, and learn boss patterns through repeat runs. Install the Mech Assemble: Zombie Swarm APK to set it up on your device and begin your first build.

description:
Dash, jump, double-jump and slide your way through a colourful retro pixel platformer!

Penguin Dash is a 2D platform adventure inspired by classic 16-bit games. Join a brave little penguin on an exciting journey across a mysterious frozen alien moon, filled with icy caves, dangerous creatures, hidden secrets and challenging platforming levels.

Explore strange worlds, collect energy crystals, rescue lost penguins and find your way back home!

**A RETRO PLATFORMER WITH A TWIST**

• Cleared — Reach the exit portal and finish the level.

• Under Par — Beat the target time and prove your speed.

• Flawless — Complete the level without taking a single hit.

Can you earn all three stars on every level?

Practice your jumps, discover shortcuts and master each stage to achieve the perfect run.

**EXPLORE A MYSTERIOUS ALIEN WORLD**

Adventure through Frostfall Landing, a frozen world filled with fascinating environments and surprising dangers.

Discover:

• Slippery ice and frozen platforms

• Underground crystal caves

• Moving and drifting platforms

• Climbable vines and alien vegetation

• Deep water and low-gravity areas

• Hidden paths and secret levels

Each level introduces new challenges to test your platforming skills.

**BATTLE STRANGE ALIEN CREATURES**

The frozen moon is full of surprises!

Dodge crystal-mimic berries that spring to life, avoid teleporting moon orchids, escape dangerous spores and watch out for the snapping Frost Mouth.

Face the mighty Glacial Maw in an epic boss showdown!

Learn enemy patterns, time your movements and use your platforming skills to survive.

**COLLECT CRYSTALS AND RESCUE PENGUINS**

Explore every corner of the alien moon to discover energy crystals, hidden secrets and penguin friends waiting to be rescued.

Take the safest route to the exit or risk exploring dangerous areas for more discoveries.

**GAME FEATURES**

• Classic 2D platforming with colourful 16-bit pixel art

• Responsive running, double-jumping and belly-sliding

• 8 handcrafted levels in Frostfall Landing

• Three-star challenges on every level

• Time trials and secret bonus stages

• Unique alien enemies and a challenging boss battle

• Crystals to collect and penguins to rescue

• Moving platforms, icy surfaces and low-gravity zones

• Frequent checkpoints to keep the adventure moving

• Smooth touchscreen controls

• Keyboard and game controller support

• Family-friendly cartoon action

• Offline gameplay with local saves

• No account or login required

• More worlds planned for future updates

**EASY TO PLAY, FUN TO MASTER**

Whether you love classic platform games, pixel art adventures, speedrunning challenges or simply exploring colourful worlds, Penguin Dash has something for you.

New players can enjoy the adventure at their own pace, while experienced platformer fans can chase faster times, flawless runs and hidden secrets.

With responsive controls, short challenges and plenty of opportunities to improve, there's always a reason to play another level.

**CAN YOU HELP THE LITTLE PENGUIN GET HOME?**

An alien moon. A mysterious portal. One brave penguin.

Collect crystals, rescue your friends, defeat the Glacial Maw and dash your way home!

Start your Penguin Dash adventure today!

description:
Grim is a fast 2D multiplayer shooting game. Four players, one arena, three-minute matches, and one hit is all it takes.

No aiming. Movement is the skill.

There is no aiming stick. Your shots fly straight ahead in the direction you face, so every fight is won with your feet. Run, jump, glide, crouch and slide across the platforms, get level with a rival and fire first.

Scramble for weapons

Pistols, Shotguns and Grenades appear on the arena floor. Walk over one to pick it up, then fight everyone else for the next one. Throw your weapon at a rival to knock theirs out of their hands.

One hit, quick comeback

No health bars. One clean hit is a knockout, and you are back in the fight two seconds later.

Three-minute matches

In Casual and Deathmatch, the first player to 8 knockouts wins. If nobody gets there, the top score wins when time runs out. A tie goes to 15 seconds of sudden death.

Team up 2v2

Queue for 2v2 on your own or invite a friend onto your team, and take on the other pair together.

Play with friends

Add friends and open a private room for free-for-all or 2v2.

Learn it, then climb

Learn the controls in Practice, then play Casual matches. After ten Casual matches, Deathmatch unlocks: win to earn trophies and climb the leagues.

Level up NOVA

Earn Coins and Power Points in Casual and 2v2 matches and build NOVA's Hero Mastery. It unlocks Dash, a quick burst that makes you untouchable for a split second, and later upgrades shorten its cooldown.

Something every day

Claim Daily Rewards, complete daily objectives, and finish three public matches a day to open the Daily Chest.

Fair by design

Grim is free to play. Every player gets the same weapons, the same movement and the same one-hit rule. In matches, Hero Mastery only unlocks Dash and shortens its cooldown.

Early Access

Grim is in Early Access with one hero, NOVA, one arena and three weapons. More heroes are coming soon. Online matchmaking can fill empty slots so a match starts quickly, and an internet connection is required for online play.

Grab a gun, find your angle and jump into your first arena fight.

description:
BombSquad suits quick matches with friends on a couch or short sessions online when you have a few minutes to spare. The game focuses on fast rounds where timing and simple controls matter, so you can jump in and out without a long setup. Meanwhile, flexible input options make it easy to join using the device you have on hand. For those ready to download BombSquad, it is designed for both solo play and lively group brawls.


BombSquad Features

Eight player party multiplayer

You can play solo or with up to eight players in the same room or over a network. Local matches work well for living room sessions, and LAN play supports shared hotspots and home networks. As a result, BombSquad scales from one on one skirmishes to crowded free for all battles.

Game modes and characters

BombSquad offers a mix of mini games including Capture the Flag, King of the Hill, Bomber Hockey, and Epic Slow Motion Elimination. Each mode focuses on clear objectives, so matches stay simple to learn but hard to predict. Along the way, you can pick from quirky heroes such as pirates, ninjas, barbarians, and chefs to give each brawl a distinct look.

Hilarious physics

Ragdoll movement and face plant collisions turn every round into a slapstick scramble. Explosions knock players off platforms, and unexpected falls change momentum in an instant. This keeps strategies fluid and makes outcomes feel different from match to match.

Wide controller support and phone control

BombSquad supports touchscreens, keyboards, USB or Bluetooth gamepads, and familiar console controllers such as PS3 or Xbox 360. You can also use the BombSquad Remote app to turn a phone into a wireless controller. This is useful when playing on a TV or set top device where a standard gamepad might not be available.

Community and customization

BombSquad includes an official Python API along with modding guides and hosting documentation. Players can create custom mini games, run private servers, and tune rules to fit their group. In turn, the community can build and share new experiences beyond the default modes.


BombSquad controller notes

You can mix touch controls with gamepads and phones using BombSquad Remote, so different devices can join the same match. On Android TV, plan to use a compatible gamepad or a phone running the remote app. This ensures smooth control when playing on a big screen.


Online and LAN play basics

BombSquad supports networked multiplayer where you host or join matches over a local network or the internet. LAN sessions work well for low latency party play in the same location. Online play depends on the host’s setup, and private servers are possible using the provided hosting docs, which many Android users access through the BombSquad APK.


How to play BombSquad on Android

To get started, open the game and choose a quick local match or set up a networked session. If you plan to invite friends later, consider the BombSquad latest version to keep features and modes consistent across devices.

  1. Launch BombSquad, then select Local Play for couch matches or Networked Play to host or join over a LAN or the internet.
  2. Connect controllers by using touch on your device, pairing a Bluetooth gamepad, or opening the BombSquad Remote app on a phone to join as a controller.
  3. Choose a mode such as Capture the Flag, King of the Hill, Bomber Hockey, or Elimination, and review the simple objective shown on screen.
  4. Set teams, pick characters, and adjust basic options like score limit or match length to fit your group.
  5. Start the round, then use jump, punch, pick up, and throw actions to move around and place bombs; work with teammates or adapt as the physics change.


Get started with BombSquad

BombSquad focuses on quick, physics heavy brawls that work for both solo practice and party sessions. When you are ready to play with friends, download BombSquad and set up a local or networked match in minutes.

For official resources and support, refer to the links below.

  • Official website: https://www.froemling.net/apps/bombsquad
  • Support email: support@froemling.net

Auto-exclusion

Choisissez un sport, sélectionnez un événement et un marché, indiquez votre mise, puis vérifiez et confirmez votre ticket.

description:
**Welcome to Jericho: Survival Mission**

A massive research complex stands in an infected city.

Seven floors. An underground parking garage. Laboratories, corridors, and sealed doors with no telling what waits behind them.

Thousands once worked here.

Now, there is only silence.

The lights still burn. Security systems carry out forgotten orders. Warnings flash across monitors with no one left to read them.

The complex does not want you here.

You are not a hero sent to save humanity. You are one person trapped inside a deadly maze. Make your way through the infected floors, complete your mission, and find a way out.

Assuming one still exists.

**A Story of Survival**

No armies are coming. There is no endless supply of ammunition and no safe place where you can forget what may be waiting behind the next door.

There is only you, the weapon in your hands, the weak beam of your flashlight, and creatures that feel at home in the dark.

**Survival Begins with Silence**

Not every fight is worth taking.

Sometimes the smarter choice is to crouch, turn off your flashlight, and move without making a sound.

Enemies may be waiting in the next room, hiding among the furniture, or crawling out of the vents just when you think the danger has passed.

Listen. Watch. Take your time.

One mistake can ruin your entire plan.

**Think Before You Shoot**

You cannot force your way through the complex.

Ammo runs out. Medical supplies must be rationed. Valuable equipment is hidden in places no reasonable person would enter.

Plant mines. Set traps. Cut off enemy routes. Lure them out one at a time—or avoid them completely.

Noise attracts attention, and attention rarely ends well here.

**Explore the Complex**

Abandoned offices. Medical facilities. Sealed laboratories. Dark storage rooms. An underground parking garage where no engine has run in a long time.

Along the way, you will face:

• story missions and optional objectives;

• infected and restricted areas;

• traps and active security systems;

• limited weapons and resources;

• enemies with different behaviors;

• hidden supplies and equipment;

• choices whose consequences may appear later.

Almost no safe routes remain.

Maybe there never were any.

**Fight When There Is No Other Choice**

Use firearms, close-quarters combat, and tactical movement.

Dodge attacks. Control the distance. Use the environment and watch your back.

Some enemies strike from the darkness. Others try to surround you. The most dangerous wait until you waste your ammunition or let your guard down.

Sometimes you will have a few seconds to decide.

Sometimes only one.

**Death Is Part of the Journey**

Died? Start again.

You may lose almost everything, but you keep what matters most: knowledge.

Now you remember where the trap was, which door hid an ambush, and which fight should have been avoided.

Every attempt makes you more careful.

But the complex can still surprise you.

**Built for Mobile**

• intuitive touch controls;

• aim assist and target lock;

• graphics, brightness, and contrast settings;

• seamless streaming throughout the complex;

• tense combat and dangerous expeditions;

• cinematic environments.

A survival experience built for mobile.

**An Atmosphere That Makes You Stop and Listen**

Footsteps in the next hallway.

A flickering light.

A door creaking open when no one touched it.

Movement beyond the reach of your flashlight.

Jericho: Survival Mission does not try to scare you every second. It lets the silence do the work.

Sometimes nothing happens.

That is when the fear hits hardest.

If you enjoy the atmosphere of Resident Evil, the tension of Alien: Isolation, the brutality of Darkwood, and the vulnerability of Endoparasitic, enter the research complex.

Complete the mission. Find the exit.

And try not to become another person who almost made it out.

Ram the enemy with Gun Bit Strike, or trap a moving enemy in the Curtain Beam. Its special, Ultra-Fast Sniper Shot, blows the enemy away with one ultra-fast shot that scatters beyond it, and raises an all-around barrier.

In AI battles, pick the battlefield on the battle prep screen: the rocky Wasteland, the Colony, a space-colony town of buildings and terraces, the flat open Moon, or Random. Online battles are fought in the Wasteland.

Crescent slashes, a five-strike Iai, a giant irradiation beam, a five-beam funnel line, Holy Beam, Grand Cross, Shishi Funjin, Kumogakure, Purge, the Giant Bomb Grenade Barrage, Deadeye Shot and Ultra-Fast Sniper Shot.

◆ Twelve gears, twelve fighting styles

- Stan Gear: balanced shooting and melee, ready for any range.

- Sword Stan Gear: a greatsword melee specialist.

- Launcher Stan Gear: a high-power shooter whose planted beam knocks down in one hit.

- Astra Gear: a shooting-leaning all-rounder with funnels (cost 3).

- Seraphim Gear: agile flight and a lance for attacks from every angle (cost 3).

- Diabolos Gear: a greatsword and gliding strikes to run the enemy down (cost 3).

- Shishiou Gear: a samurai who pulls you in and cuts you down (cost 3).

- Kagerou Gear: a ninja who confuses with afterimages.

- Nova Gear: a heavy shooter that purges into an agile winged form (cost 3).

- Ranger Gear: beams and bombs to support the team (cost 1).

- Gun Veil Gear: a gunslinger who keeps firing on the move.

- Orion Gear: a sniper with gun bits and a barrier (cost 3).

- Random: a different gear every sortie.

Slide up on the beam or saber button for each gear's sub shot or sub melee, and check every gear's moves anytime on the Gears screen in battle prep.

◆ Test your skills online

- Random match: find an opponent automatically for a 1v1 battle.

- Friend match: create a room and share the code to battle your friends.

- Gear select: choose your favorite gear online too.

- Record card: tracks your matches, win rate, wins, losses and draws.

◆ Thrilling action that flows

- Guard: block attacks from the front and repel melee to strike back.

- Boost dash: close the distance in an instant, even in midair.

- Step: shake off homing shots and dodge attacks.

- Cancel: cut your attack recovery with a boost dash. A step also cancels melee recovery.

◆ AI battles from 1v1 to 2v2

Four battle types: 1v1 / 1v2 / 2v1 / 2v2. Choose the gear for yourself, your ally and each enemy, and set each AI's difficulty to one of four levels.

Take your best moves into the next battle.

Pilot your gear in X-Gears.

• Pure skill-based action with no shortcuts

• Analyze and master the prison's defense patterns

• Position the polygon and dodge the obstacles with precision

• Increase the polygon’s sides to multiply damage

• Deal damage to the prison at the right moment

• A ruthless obstacle-bouncing mechanic

• 20+ exclusive stages in Time Trial Mode

• Eternal Mode and Ranking System

🎮 Unique Gameplay – Prison Attack

• Dodge: Tap or drag to avoid the obstacles and save your attack timing wisely. One solid blow from them sets off a powerful bounce with heavy recoil! Any tap or drag during Super Charge or while bouncing will be queued and carried out after the recoil ends.

• Charge: Collect Energy, then tap or drag beyond the prison wall and charge to deal damage. After the charge, a control cooldown kicks in due to the recoil.

• Super Charge: Back off from the wall and unleash Super Charge! It deals massive damage to the prison. But once you commit, it cannot be stopped. Until the polygon reaches its max sides, you instantly gain 2 small Energy when dealing damage.

• Destroy: When the prison's durability is completely depleted, it shatters. Clear the prison as quickly as possible to set a record for the best time!

🔥 Challenge – Eternal Mode

Eternal Mode is the ultimate challenge reserved for those who have mastered nearly every defense pattern of the prison. Deal as much damage as you can and carve your name into the global leaderboard!

description:
Pixel Gun 3D suits players who want to switch between brief online matches and activities that continue over time. The game uses a pixel based visual style and places you in first person combat against other players, monsters, and bosses. You can choose an activity based on whether you prefer direct competition, teamwork, or longer clan goals. Before installing the Pixel Gun 3D APK, consider which of these play styles fits the time you usually spend playing.


Pixel Gun 3D features

Weapons, gadgets, and loadouts

Pixel Gun 3D includes more than 1,000 weapons to collect and upgrade. The selection covers firearms, melee weapons, magic gear, grenades, and over 40 gadgets. You can prepare a loadout for the activity you plan to enter, then adjust it as you unlock different equipment.

Competitive multiplayer modes

You can join Battle Royale, Team Fight, Deathmatch, Duels, Imposter Mode, and rotating brawls. Some modes focus on individual results, while others require players to work with a team. Duels provide a one on one option, whereas Battle Royale places more emphasis on staying active until the match ends.

Maps, campaigns, and raids

Pixel Gun 3D has more than 150 maps with different routes, cover areas, elevated positions, and themes. Learning where opponents can approach from can affect how you move and which weapon you use. Outside regular multiplayer, you can fight monsters in the solo campaign or join up to three other players for raids with bosses.

Clan objectives and progression

You can create a clan or join an existing one to take part in shared objectives. Clans can customize forts, capture territories, collect valor points, and move through divisions. In addition, PvE Sieges and tank raids give clan members activities that differ from standard player versus player matches.

Character skins and mini games

Pixel Gun 3D lets you change your character through skins and the Skin Editor. When you want a break from shooting matches, you can enter activities such as Parkour Challenge, Sniper Tournament, Glider Rush, and racing. These options use different rules and controls from the main combat modes.


Pixel Gun 3D community activities

Main Rollance Features

Physics based rolling control

Rollance uses physics based movement, so each roll, jump, fall, and balance moment reacts to your timing. You guide the ball across tracks where speed can help, but careless movement can send it off the path. Because of this, the game feels easy to start while still requiring practice to finish harder stages.

Obstacle courses with changing hazards

Rollance Adventure Balls builds its stages around different barriers that affect how you move. You may face ramps, pendulums, trampolines, hammers, narrow roads, and other traps along the way. In later sections, these obstacles can appear close together, so you need to read the path ahead before pushing the ball forward.

Simple controls for fast or careful play

You control the ball with simple tap based actions, which makes the game easy to understand on a phone screen. At the same time, Rollance does not rely only on speed. You often need to slow down, line up the ball, and move through tight areas without falling, especially when platforms are narrow or hazards are moving.

Boosters, bonuses, and ball changes

Rollance includes boosters and bonuses that can change how the ball handles during a run. These items may help the ball become bigger, stronger, or faster, which can affect how it passes certain obstacles. However, players still need control, because a faster ball can also be harder to manage on sharp turns or small platforms.

Levels, skins, and 3D presentation

Rollance offers many levels and dozens of ball skins, giving players visual variety while they repeat stages and improve their timing. The 3D graphics make platforms, ramps, and moving objects easy to see during play. In addition, the calm rolling sound and ASMR style feel can make short sessions relaxing, even when the stage itself becomes tense.


Things to Know About Rollance

Rollance Android gameplay is designed for single player arcade sessions, so it fits users who prefer casual action, platformer style movement, and quick retries. The game can be played as a short break, but harder stages may take several attempts because movement depends on balance and timing. This makes it suitable for both beginners who want simple controls and skilled players who like precision challenges.

Rollance is free to play and may include ads and optional in app purchases. This is important to know before installing, especially if you prefer uninterrupted play or want to avoid spending inside a game. The core experience focuses on guiding the ball through stages, while extra items or options can support play without replacing the need for skill.


How to Play Rollance on Android

Rollance is simple to begin, but steady progress depends on reading each track before moving too fast. After installing the Rollance APK, you can start with the early levels to learn how the ball responds to taps, ramps, and turns.

  1. Open Rollance on your Android phone and choose a level from the available stage list.
  2. Start rolling forward slowly at first, then watch the track shape, gaps, and moving obstacles ahead.
  3. Use taps to increase speed when the path is clear, but reduce movement before narrow roads or swinging hazards.
  4. Collect useful boosters and bonuses when they are safe to reach, then adjust your control if the ball becomes faster or larger.
  5. Keep the ball on the platform until it reaches the finish line, then replay stages to improve timing and avoid earlier mistakes.


Start Rolling in Rollance

description:
Shark Universe suits players who want quick action during short sessions or commutes. It places you in a living sea where hunger guides choices, and steady upgrades turn early escapes into confident hunts. As difficulty rises, clear goals and familiar routes keep decisions simple. Updates add regions and varied creatures, so repeat runs stay fresh. When ready to try this survival loop, download Shark Universe and expect incremental progress that builds each time you return.


Shark Universe Features

Eat and survive

You roam busy waters and bite anything that moves. Targets include fish, divers, whales, ships, and even aircraft if you leap at the right moment. The hunt loop is direct, so quick choices and clean paths turn chaos into steady growth.

Evolve and upgrade

After the core loop clicks, species progression reshapes hunts. You move from baby forms toward Great White, Hammerhead, and Megalodon. Coins and resources invested in speed, health, and damage open new targets and make tougher routes manageable.

World and regions

  • Reefs, wrecks, deep trenches, and hidden caves to discover
  • Ice, Atlantis, and Lava regions with distinct hazards
  • Encounters with submarines, mermaids, lava crabs, and turtles
  • Surprise monster spawns that keep patrols active

Bosses and offline play

Major fights test builds against giant whales, submarines, and deep sea beasts. Destroying ships and subs awards resources, so careful routes through shipping lanes pay off. Between sessions, offline play with idle auto swim earns rewards. Ads may appear during play; an ad free option usually removes forced ads, while optional reward ads can remain if chosen.


Start playing Shark Universe

Shark Universe focuses on quick hunts, clear upgrades, and open exploration that works online or offline. Install the Shark Universe latest version, confirm storage space, and begin with small routes while boosting speed, health, and damage. Short sessions still move progress forward and prepare you for larger fights.

description:
Pixel Gun 2 is a multiplayer shooter built on disruption — of old rules, map architecture, traditional loadouts and more!

Short matches. Destructible arenas. Wild builds. Non-stop FPS action. Ever-evolving world. A piece of controlled mayhem that fits in your pocket — or takes over your evening. Jump in for a few PvP battles or lose track of time (with no regrets).

Experiment with loadouts, improvise in ever-changing environments, embrace the chaos, and make the most out of the reality-bending Pixelstorm!

EVERY MATCH HITS DIFFERENT

Change is the only constant in Pixel Gun 2. The battle arena starts falling apart with every shot fired. Creative builds clash, throwing surprises at everyone involved.

As the PvP match goes on, you evolve too — stacking perks, adapting on the fly, and leaning into whatever the situation demands. Will you end up a life-stealing headshot machine, a melee juggernaut, a speed-running gadgeteer — or something nobody saw coming?

Next time it will be different. And that’s the point.

WRECK HAVOC. MAKE A MESS

Pixel Gun 2 maps are breaking apart — and you’d better take advantage of it.

Use the destructible environment for smart tactical moves or just for the sake of pure fun. No cover is built to last. If something’s in your way — blow a hole through it. If someone’s camping — make a few “architectural adjustments” to their hiding spot.

You’re not here to build. You’re here to destroy. The battlefield keeps changing — and so do your options.

YOUR CHARACTER. YOUR BUILD. YOUR VIBE

Pixel Gun 2 is all about playing your way.

Mix characters, weapons, gadgets, armor, perks, and abilities into builds that feel powerful, clever, aggressive, weird — or all of the above.

Get creative. Break the meta. Find something that just clicks.

CROSS DIMENSIONS. MORE PLATFORMS AHEAD.

Start your journey on mobile, with Pixel Gun 2 coming to PC in the future. Cross-platform play and shared progression are planned, so your progress and rewards can travel with you between devices.

Play now — and stay tuned for PC release news.

THE PIXELSTORM IS RISING

The world of Pixel Gun 2 isn’t about order or stability — it’s about constant change and adaptation.

A strange calamity keeps bending the rules of reality, opening new possibilities (and dangers) over time. New heroes, gear, abilities, seasons, game modes, and even entire worlds appear in this ever-shifting multiverse.

Pixel Gun 2 is a mobile first-person shooter that evolves around — and for — you. Expect the unexpected.

description:
Mythic Survivors is designed for players who want short combat runs where each choice can change how a hero fights. You select a class, face groups of enemies, and develop your character as the battle continues. The game combines chapter progression with repeatable survival focused encounters, so players can try different approaches over multiple runs. Before installing the Mythic Survivors APK, consider whether you enjoy action games built around repeated battles, character growth, and adapting to large enemy waves.


Combat and progression features

Hero classes with different combat styles

Mythic Survivors lets you choose from heroes with distinct classes. Each class changes your combat approach, giving you a different starting point for handling enemies. You can switch heroes between runs to test how their styles fit your preferred way of fighting.

3D battles against large enemy waves

You fight in 3D arenas where enemies arrive in large groups. Mythic Survivors asks you to keep moving, attack at the right time, and manage pressure as the battlefield fills up. As a result, positioning matters alongside the weapons and skills you choose.

Weapons, spells, and build choices

You can shape a run with combat options such as swords, bows, and magic spells. Skills and upgrades can be combined to create a specialized build for the current hero. This system gives you room to try a close range setup in one run and a spell focused setup in another.

Hyper Skills for difficult situations

Mythic Survivors includes Hyper Skills that can be activated during combat. These powerful abilities are intended for dangerous hordes and difficult encounters. Using them at the right moment can help when regular attacks are not enough to control the situation.

Chapters, bosses, and Rift Battles

You progress through chapters that include increasingly challenging fights and massive bosses. In addition, Rift Battles provide a separate high pressure survival activity. These battles focus on staying alive while dealing with intense enemy attacks.


Mythic Survivors rewards and official resources

The official Mythic Survivors website includes a Gift Code redemption page. Players who receive a valid gift code can check the official page for redemption details and available reward related information. This resource may be useful before or after starting the game, especially when a code is shared through an official event or announcement.


How to play Mythic Survivors

Mythic Survivors starts each run by asking you to choose a hero and enter a combat area. The Mythic Survivors latest version may include the same core loop of fighting enemies, selecting upgrades, and advancing through available encounters. Focus on your current build instead of choosing every option in the same way each time.

  1. Open the game and choose a hero class that matches the combat style you want to try.

  2. Enter a chapter or available battle, then move through the arena while attacking incoming enemy groups.

  3. As the run develops, select weapons, skills, and upgrades that work together for your chosen hero.

  4. Save Hyper Skills for moments when a large horde or difficult enemy puts your hero under pressure.

  5. Continue through chapter encounters, prepare for boss fights, or select Rift Battles when you want a survival focused challenge.


Start a Mythic Survivors run

Mythic Survivors is a class based action game centered on surviving hordes and adjusting your build during each run. Players can download Mythic Survivors to try different heroes, weapon types, skills, bosses, and Rift Battles on Android.

Official information is available through the developer’s channels:

  • Website: https://mythicsurvivors.games/

  • Support email: support@mythicsurvivors.games

description:
You wake on a floor you don't recognise. The door is locked. Somewhere

below you, something heavy is walking.

He knows this house. He hears you.

THE BUTCHER is a first-person survival horror game about being hunted.

You have no weapon and no way to fight back — only a torch, a house full

of places to hide, and the time between his footsteps.

FIND A WAY OUT

Search the rooms for keys and tools. Every drawer you open makes a sound.

Every second you spend looking is a second he spends getting closer.

HIDE, AND HOPE HE PASSES

Slide under a bed. Climb into a chest. Hold still and watch him search the

room through the gap. He checks the places you would think of.

RUN WHEN YOU HAVE TO

Sprinting drains fast and takes a while to come back. Choosing the moment

to break cover is the whole game.

THREE DIFFICULTIES THAT REALLY CHANGE IT

Easy — 3 lives. He keeps pace with you at a walk and loses you the

moment you run.

Normal — 2 lives. He gains on you unless you spend stamina.

Nightmare — 1 life. He sees further, hears more, reacts instantly and is

nearly as fast as your sprint. Hiding is the only real answer.

BUILT FOR TOUCH

Swipe anywhere to look. The movement stick appears wherever your thumb

lands. Left-handed layout, adjustable sensitivity and control size, and an

optional on-screen turn stick if you prefer one.

No jump-scare corridor. A house, a hunter, and the decision of when to move.

description:
Classic 5v5 shooter: bomb defusal, team battle, deathmatch. Online, LAN, bots.

Full description: Counter Assault brings the spirit of the legendary 1999 tactical shooters to your phone: 5v5 multiplayer action with an authoritative server, real hit registration and controls built for touch. Short matches, no filler.

GAME MODES

💣 Bomb defusal (5v5) — Terrorists plant, SWAT defuses. Freeze time at the start of each round, a money economy, weapon and armour shopping. When you die you wait out the round watching your teammates.

🎯 Team Deathmatch — No rounds; you respawn 3 seconds after dying. The match ends when your team's total kills hit the limit. Friendly fire is off.

🔫 Deathmatch — Free for all with a weapon ladder: you start with the cheapest gun and move up every 2 kills. First to finish the ladder wins.

🧟 Zombie — Three zombies, seven humans. Everyone the claws touch turns. Rounds keep going until someone reaches 30 kills; it does not affect your rank.

HOW TO PLAY

🌍 Online — Sign in with your Google account, queue up and climb the ranks. Nine tiers from BRONZE to ELITE OPS, with 5 placement matches to start.

📶 LAN — Phones on the same network find each other automatically. No server needed.

🤖 With bots — Offline and solo. Fill the field with as many bots as you like and manage both sides separately.

🎖️ Offline Missions — 16 missions against bots in 2 chapters. Three stars per mission; finish a chapter for a case, three-star it for a key.

👥 Friends — Add friends, invite them to your party and drop into the same match together.

FEATURES

🔫 24 weapons and grenades — Rifles, snipers, shotguns, SMGs and pistols, plus the knife; HE, flash, smoke and molotov. Bots throw them too.

🎮 Place your own buttons — Fire, jump, aim: drag every button wherever your thumb wants it. Positions are saved.

🧭 Gyro aiming — Optional: aim by turning the phone. Touch look keeps working alongside it.

⚙️ Tuned for weaker phones — Five quality levels and a 60/120/144 fps cap, with a live fps counter in game so you can see what each setting does.

⭐ Levels and daily missions — Every match gives XP, online matches double. Level up to unlock avatar frames; three new missions every day.

🗣️ Five languages — Turkish, English, Russian, Spanish, Arabic.

🎥 Match replays — After a suspicious match, the reported player's recording can be reviewed.

SKINS AND CRATES

🎁 Five crates, 57 skins — Win an online match and a crate drops; opening it needs a key. Keys drop rarely after a match, or can be bought in the store. Crates never drop in LAN or bot matches.

📊 Published odds — Rarity of the skin you get: Mil-Spec 59% · Restricted 25% · Classified 10% · Covert 5% · Special Item (knife) 1%. Every opening is independent and the draw runs on the server. The same table is shown in game on the crate screen.

Skins are cosmetic only: no skin changes a weapon's damage, accuracy or handling.

The game is free and shows ads; ads appear only in the menus, never during a match. It offers optional in-app purchases (crate keys, ad-free pack, Royal Pass); buying nothing is required to play. An account is optional: LAN and bot matches need no sign-in.
whats_new: NEW: Grenades! HE, flashbang, smoke and molotov (incendiary for CT) with CS:GO prices — buy them in Bomb and Team Deathmatch, throw with the new GRENADE button. Smoke puts out fire, bots throw them too. Crosshair customization in settings. Dropped weapons keep their skin and show the owner's name. Nicknames are now unique. Game icon on startup instead of the engine logo. Bomb mode fixes.

description:
Halloween: Jack O' Lantern is a Halloween platformer about a hero with a pumpkin for a head and a bag that is never full enough. Run, jump and stomp through ten long levels of mummies, fireballs and candy.

Of all the halloween games about pumpkins, this is the one where the pumpkin does the stomping. Collect candy as you go, then spend it on upgrades that make your hero faster, tougher and much harder to stop.

ONE LONG HALLOWEEN NIGHT

Under a huge full moon, you run across graveyards and down into a pharaoh's tomb.

• Jump on mummies to flatten them.

• Double jump over the wide gaps and bounce off springs.

• Ride moving platforms, and keep moving on the bricks that drop the moment you land.

• Hit blocks from below to smash bricks and fill your bag with candy.

• Hold the fire button to sprint and throw fireballs at anything that gets too close.

Take a hit and you lose your fireballs, so look out for the power-ups hidden in blocks: one gives the fireballs back, another restores a heart.

TEN LONG LEVELS

Each level is a long run with a checkpoint torch past the halfway mark, so one slip near the end does not send you back to the start. Mummies, beetles, vultures, rats, scorpions, carnivorous plants and giant rock golems stand between you and the goal. Clear a level to open the next, and come back any time to beat your best time or your candy record.

SPEND YOUR CANDY

Candy is more than a score. Five upgrades, each with several levels:

• Speed: run faster

• Jump: jump higher

• Fireballs: more damage, faster shots

• Extra heart: take one more hit

• Candy magnet: pull in the candy nearby

Every level can be beaten without upgrades. With them, it is a sweeter run.

TRICK OR TREAT, 15 TIMES

From Trick or Treat! to Pumpkin King, 15 achievements reward clearing levels, collecting candy, stomping monsters and finishing without a scratch. The stats screen counts every candy, stomp, fireball, jump and minute played, if you like to keep score.

PLAY YOUR WAY

On touch screens the buttons sit in a strip below the action, so your thumbs never cover the level. Make them bigger or smaller, change their opacity or switch to a left-handed layout. Keyboard and gamepad work on every screen, menus included. Screen shake and vibration can be turned off, and the game comes in 14 languages.

A PUMPKIN GAME FOR OCTOBER (AND AFTER)

If you go looking for halloween games every autumn, this one is a proper platformer rather than a coloring book: one of those spooky games that never gets truly scary, with crisp HD art, mummies to stomp and a pumpkin hero with a fire problem. It works just as well in March.

Carve out ten minutes, grab your pumpkin and go trick or treating. Halloween: Jack O' Lantern is one of those halloween games where every level hides another bag of candy.

Street Capital is an open world car game set in one seamless 3D city. Steal cars straight out of moving traffic, drive across the whole map without a loading screen, explore on foot or at the wheel, and buy what you want with what you earn.

Here is what you can do in the city right now.

🚗 Steal and drive 10 cars

Walk up to a car on the street, pull the driver out, and drive away. It takes about three seconds. Five of the ten cars run in live traffic, so you can take them off the road at any time. The other five you go and find. Each one is handcrafted with its own handling: a boxy V8 muscle car does not corner like a mid-engine supercar.

🏙️ Explore one seamless city

Drive from the waterfront to the far side of downtown in a single unbroken run, with no loading screens between districts. Traffic moves around you, pedestrians walk the pavements, and doors open — you can go inside buildings, take the coast road, or head for the horizon.

🌊 Swim, sink and dive

Drive off the pier and your car sinks. Jump in and swim. The ocean is part of the map, not a wall at the edge of it.

👕 Change how you look

Pick new clothes at the clothing store and build a look that sticks.

🔫 Pick up weapons

Find weapons around the city and handle whoever gets in your way. The streets are not empty and not everyone out there is friendly.

💵 Earn and shop

Everything you do in the world earns Cash. Take it to the storefronts and pick up cars, clothes and gear. Everything you own is saved to your account, so your city is still your city on your next phone.

🎮 Play it your way

There is no forced tutorial and nothing you have to complete before the map opens. Steal a car in the first ten seconds if you want to. Street Capital is an open world action sandbox and the whole city is unlocked from the start.

⚙️ Made for mid-range phones

Built around mid-range Android hardware from the start, rather than scaled down from a console build afterwards.

About this release

Street Capital is in beta and available worldwide. The city, the cars, the driving and the shops described above are all playable today. More content arrives in regular updates, and what beta players report shapes what we build next.

Street Capital is free to play and offers optional in-app purchases. An internet connection is required to sign in and sync your progress.

Made by Bombowave Games, an independent studio.

Ricochet Squad is a 3v3 multiplayer PvP hero shooter where physics driven abilities, destructible objects, and vertical movement mean no two matches play out the same way twice.

Truly Interactive

Forget flat, static maps. Every object in the arena reacts to what you do. Grab a meteorite mid fight, pull enemies into a black hole, or knock them off a ledge with a gravity blast. Heroes have physics based abilities that interact with the environment and each other. The combos you can pull off aren't scripted, they're real. Multi level arenas with vertical gameplay mean fights happen above, below and all around you.

Master Your Hero

Every hero plays different, so find the one that fits your style. Rush in as a brawler, hold the line as a tank, back up your team as support or pick off enemies from range with sniper. But choosing the right hero is just the start. It's not only about which abilities you use, but how you move and position yourself. Controls are simple to learn but give you real precision in this action shooter - auto aim keeps things fast while smart positioning wins fights.

Squad Up and Rank Up

This isn't a solo carry game. Winning takes real teamwork. Combine hero abilities for devastating synergies, coordinate pushes, and cover each other's weaknesses. Matches are fast, just 3 to 5 minutes, so every second counts. Find your squad, experiment with different hero combos, and climb the ranked ladder together.

Your Ship, Your Progress

description:
Draw. Loop. Bind. It's that simple — and wildly satisfying.

Trail Bind is a hypercasual puzzle-action game where you control a glowing trail by dragging your finger across the screen. Surround wandering enemies by drawing a loop around them, and watch them snap together and vanish in a slick binding animation. The fewer swipes you need, the better!

### HOW TO PLAY

- **Drag** your finger to move the glowing trail across the arena

- **Loop** the trail around one or more enemies to encircle them

- When the trail **crosses itself**, it forms a lasso — any enemies trapped inside get bound!

- Bound enemies **contract together** and disappear in a satisfying crush effect

- New enemies keep spawning — keep drawing to clear them all!

### FEATURES

- **Intuitive one-finger drag controls** — pick up and play in seconds

- **Satisfying binding animation** — enemies pull together and squash out with a crunchy finish

- **Chain multiple enemies** in a single loop for big combo clears

- **Endless replayability** — enemies spawn continuously, no two rounds play the same

- **Minimalist neon art style** — glowing cyan trail on a sleek dark background

- **Physics-driven movement** — enemies wander freely with smooth, organic motion

- **Progressively challenging levels** — more enemies, tighter spaces, faster pace

### THE CHALLENGE

The trick is crossing your own trail cleanly to close the loop at just the right moment. Move too slowly and enemies walk free; swing too wide and you waste precious moves. Master the art of the perfect lasso — one fluid arc that catches a crowd — and feel the rush as they all snap together at once.

The binding mechanic has depth: enemies caught in the same loop are pulled toward each other before being crushed. Catch several enemies in a single lasso for maximum combo satisfaction. But be careful — the binding radius is tight, so precise looping is key.

### PERFECT FOR

- Casual players who love satisfying one-tap mechanics

- Anyone who enjoys a clean, minimal aesthetic with punchy feedback

- Fans of lasso, rope, and drawing puzzle games

- Quick sessions on the go — rounds last as long as you want

Put your loop skills to the test. How many can you bind in one swipe?

description:
Cleanup Survivor is a survival action game: sweep away huge hordes of trash monsters with cleaning tools, stay alive and take down the boss of each site. Attacking is automatic, so you can play with one hand.

Everywhere you walk and every enemy you defeat leaves the dirty city a little cleaner.

It is a roguelike at heart: every level-up you pick one of three cleaning tools, combine them into a build and evolve them. The choices change every run, so no two runs play the same.

■ How to play

• Drag a finger to move (on PC, drag with the mouse or use WASD/arrow keys). Attacking is automatic.

• Every level-up, pick one of three Cleaning Tools or Support upgrades. A tool at Lv 5 with its matching Support can evolve from a level-up or a Treasure Chest.

• The longer you survive, the more waves of weak trash pour in until they fill the screen. Mowing them down with your upgraded tools is the fun part.

• A Mini-boss arrives at 50% Clean and the site's Boss at 90%. Beat the Boss to clear the site. Mini-bosses and tough enemies drop Treasure Chests.

• From your second run, pick an "HQ Support" at the start and after you beat the Mini-boss, such as stronger tools or more EXP. More unlock as you play.

• Your very first run starts gentler: for about a minute there are fewer enemies and you take less damage.

■ Sites and bosses

• Many sites to clean, from Practice Alley to Oily Seaside, Dark Sewers, Downtown at Night, the Junk House Maze and more.

• Most sites have a special rule: slippery floors, darkness, sudden bursts of grime, or breakable maze walls.

• Every site has a Mini-boss and a Boss. In later sites the Boss brings another Mini-boss along. Each Boss has its own moveset.

• Four kinds of grime: Sticky Goo, Dead Grass, Trash and Soot. Tools that match the site's grime deal 1.3x damage.

■ Cleaners, Gear and Pets

• Each cleaner has a different starting tool and strength (attack, move speed, EXP and more).

• Equip Gear in each slot: upgrade, merge and dismantle. At higher ranks each piece gains its own signature skill.

• Pets claw enemies, fetch EXP orbs, scrub the ground, heal you, slow enemies and more. Take one along.

■ Weekly Cleaning League (rivals are CPU)

• Each league has 30 teams: you plus 29 CPU rival teams. Earn points by playing sites; the week closes every Monday at 0:00 Japan time (JST).

• Top teams move up and bottom teams move down. Leagues run from Rookie League to Legend League. Rewards such as Gems depend on your rank.

• All rivals are CPU teams marked "CPU" on screen. Their scores rise at a pace fixed at the start of the week and never change with your results or purchases.

■ Modes and events

• Clearing sites unlocks modes you can stack: Hyper (you move very fast), Big Cleanup (enemies have 3x HP, bigger rewards) and Endless (no end, a boss every 5 minutes).

• Weekly events take turns, such as Coin Festival, Boss Hunt Week and Maze Week.

• Collab stages with other games, such as Zombie Barricade Squad.

■ Ads and purchases

• You can play through to the end without paying.

• A rewarded video plays only when you choose Revive, double your Gems and Parts, collect Treats, or undo your Power-ups to get your coins back.

• A small banner ad appears at the bottom of menu screens. It never shows during play or story scenes. No full-screen ads start by themselves.

• In-app purchases: Gems, Starter Set, Cleaner's Monthly Pass, Clean Pass, No Ads (one-time), Lifetime Card (one-time), Chapter Pack, Collab Pack, Gold Piggy Bank and Daily Items. No Ads removes the banner and gives you the ad rewards without watching.

■ Languages

The game follows your device language; change it anytime in Settings.

description:
Step onto the wooden dojo floor and fight like a master. In Stickman Master, you control a stickman martial artist in fast, cinematic 2D battles. Chain light and heavy attacks, launch enemies into the air, juggle them in mid-air combos, dash past their strikes and finish with a devastating special move. Every hit lands with weight: the screen freezes on impact, knockouts drop into slow motion, and enemies fly off the walls.

How long can you last? Each wave brings tougher stickman enemies, and every 5 waves the Warlord steps into the ring with his giant greatsword. Survive as long as you can, keep your combo going and push your style rank all the way from D to SSS.

KEY FEATURES

• Satisfying combo combat: light attacks, heavy attacks, launchers, air juggles, dodges and super moves

• Hit-stop on impact, slow-motion knockouts and wall slams make every fight feel like an anime battle

• 21 playable fighters, each with their own weapon and moveset: katana, staff, ice, fire, lightning and more

• Meet Kai, the bare-handed brawler in the red headband; Ren "Moon Blade" and his cyan crescent slashes; and Yuki "Frost Witch", surrounded by icy shards

• Wave survival mode: fight grey grunts, green archers, shield soldiers and ninjas, each needing a different approach

• Boss fight every 5 waves: dodge the Warlord's greatsword and bring him down

• Style ranking: keep the hit counter climbing and go from "Decent" to "Clean!" and up to SSS

• Hand-drawn ink art: rice-paper backgrounds, misty mountains in ink wash, a red ink sun and bold brush-stroke stickmen

• Easy to pick up, hard to master: quick, responsive controls with plenty of depth for combo experts

Whether you want a quick stick fight or a long run chasing a high score, every wave is another chance to test your skills. Pick your fighter, master their moves and show the Warlord what you've got.

Download Stickman Master and start your first fight now!

description:
HOSHIKAGE is for players who prefer short combat encounters where reading an opponent matters as much as reacting quickly. The game presents a wordless confrontation in a moonlit setting, centered on a white clad swordswoman and a fox masked figure. Instead of relying on long command menus, combat follows a direct touch based approach. Players considering the HOSHIKAGE APK can expect an action game built around defensive timing, enemy pressure, and carefully chosen attacks.


HOSHIKAGE combat features

Deflect attacks from every direction

You respond to incoming strikes by swiping up, down, left, or right. Each swipe needs to match the direction of the enemy attack. Since opponents can attack from both sides, you need to watch the screen closely and react before each blow lands.

Build a rhythm through repeated parries

HOSHIKAGE asks you to deflect consecutive strikes as enemies combine and alternate their attacks. You cannot simply focus on one opponent when several attacks arrive in sequence. As the pace changes, successful defense depends on keeping track of both direction and timing.

Use Quickening to pressure enemies

You activate Quickening by chaining successful deflections together. This system makes it easier to break an enemy's stance after you maintain a solid defensive sequence. Therefore, accurate parries do more than prevent damage, because they also create better chances to take control of the fight.

Finish staggered foes with Issen

HOSHIKAGE lets you use Issen when enemies have been staggered. Touch and hold to launch this finishing strike, which cuts down every staggered enemy in one attack. Choosing the right moment matters, since Issen works after you have opened the opponents' defenses.

Choose Story or Endless mode

You can follow the central confrontation in Story mode, where the game presents its conflict without spoken dialogue. Alternatively, Endless mode places you against continuing encounters that grow more difficult over time. This mode also lets you pursue a high score while testing how long your defensive timing holds up.

Face stronger boss opponents

HOSHIKAGE includes boss battles that place more emphasis on reaction speed, defensive timing, and consistent deflection. These opponents test whether you can recognize attacks while staying calm during longer exchanges. As a result, bosses suit players who want a more demanding version of the same sword fighting system.


What to consider before playing HOSHIKAGE

HOSHIKAGE focuses on direct action rather than dialogue driven storytelling. Story mode provides the setting of the conflict, but the narrative is wordless. Players looking for detailed conversations or text based plot explanations should keep this in mind before starting.

The game also centers on repeated timing based combat. Endless mode is useful for players who want to replay encounters for higher scores and longer survival runs. However, players who dislike reacting to fast, alternating attacks may find its main challenge demanding.


How to play HOSHIKAGE

HOSHIKAGE uses simple touch actions, but each action depends on what enemies do next. In the HOSHIKAGE latest version, take a moment to watch the attack pattern before trying to build a long defensive chain. Start with Story mode if you want to learn the flow of encounters before focusing on survival scores.

  1. Open the game and select Story mode to enter the central confrontation, or choose Endless mode when you want to face escalating enemy encounters.

  2. Watch the direction of the next incoming strike, including attacks that approach from either side of the screen.

  3. Swipe up, down, left, or right at the right time to match the attack direction and deflect it.

  4. Continue landing successful deflections to build a chain and activate Quickening, which helps you break enemy stance.

  5. When one or more enemies stagger, touch and hold to use Issen and defeat all staggered opponents with a finishing attack.


Get started with HOSHIKAGE

HOSHIKAGE is built around reading strikes, deflecting attacks, and using Issen after enemies lose their stance. Players ready to download HOSHIKAGE should expect sword fighting that rewards accurate swipes and steady timing during enemy sequences.

description:
Recover the research. Uncover the truth. Make it out alive.

Deadshift is a single-player sci-fi horror FPS for Android. Twelve research facilities have suffered catastrophic containment failures. Under Protocol Zero, you are sent to eliminate the biological threats and recover sensitive research. But the records left behind tell a different story.

TWELVE FACILITIES. ONE UNFOLDING MYSTERY.

Each facility has its own research programme: pathogen tolerance, combat augmentation, cold adaptation, cellular regeneration and more. Find the research room, examine the results and transfer its archive before you can leave. Follow the evidence from abandoned laboratories to corporate command, and discover what happened to the people inside.

FIGHT YOUR WAY THROUGH

Explore dark interiors, misty courtyards and rooftop routes. Restore access, find colour-coded keycards and shut down industrial hazards. Use medical checkpoints, recover the research and secure the facility before reaching the exit lift. Multi-level arenas, moving platforms and portals give you different ways to approach a fight.

CHOOSE YOUR FIREPOWER

Carry a pistol, automatic rifle, heavy assault rifle, double-barrel shotgun, sniper rifle and rocket launcher. Aim down sights, reload under pressure, throw grenades, place mines and strike with melee attacks. Campaign weapons carry forward, with arrival weapon racks helping you recover missed equipment.

HEAR WHAT IS COMING

Listen for approaching footsteps, hovering drones and charging enemy weapons. Use your flashlight to search dark rooms and spot the glow of infected subjects. Face close-range attackers, armed experiments, flying drones and towering biological threats. Play with music or let the facility ambience and combat sounds carry the atmosphere.

BUILD YOUR LOADOUT

Earn credits and claim campaign rewards, then improve damage, reload speed, armour capacity and ammunition reserves with permanent upgrades. Choose Explorer, Survivor or Veteran difficulty, with adjustable graphics and touch controls.

UNLOCK ENDLESS SURVIVAL

Complete all twelve campaign facilities to unlock six Survival arenas. Fight escalating waves, use the full arsenal, collect powerups and choose perks for each run. Call in an extra horde for more risk and more score, and claim Survival score rewards.

PLAY AS A GUEST

Play without an account. Optional Google sign-in supports purchases, purchase recovery and manual cloud progress backup and restore. Cloud backups do not include mid-level checkpoints.

ADS AND OPTIONAL PURCHASES

Optional rewarded videos grant credits. Automatic ads may appear between campaign facilities. Remove Ads disables automatic ads; optional rewarded videos remain available. Credit packs offer another way to buy equipment upgrades. An internet connection is required for sign-in, purchases, cloud recovery and ads.

Independently developed by Samuel Hajník.
