Make room for one more satisfying cut.

Wood Cutter: Chop & Clear is a colorful woodcutting game where a spinning axe turns crowded wooden landscapes into open paths. Guide your cutter through the level, watch wood chips scatter, and collect the targets you need before the timer runs out.

CHOP YOUR OWN PATH

Drag to steer and let your axe do the cutting. Sweep along an edge, carve through the middle, or loop back for a target you missed. Every pass changes the shape of the wood around you.

GROW AS YOU GO

Start each level small and earn experience as you cut. Your tool grows through different sizes and axe designs during the run, helping you take on more of the map. Build momentum on smaller targets, then work your way toward the bigger ones.

CLEAR THE RIGHT TARGETS

Keep an eye on your goal cards. Some challenges ask you to clear wooden areas; others send you after flowers, fruit, and other objects. Choose your route, find what's left, and finish the objectives while there is still time on the clock.

ADD A LITTLE STRATEGY

Look ahead for obstacles, find keys to open gates, and steer clear of bombs. A wide sweep can be satisfying, but a well-planned path can make all the difference when the timer is ticking.

GET A HELPING HAND

Use boosters to strengthen your cutter, point you toward remaining targets, or add extra time. Pick the help that suits the challenge and keep your run moving.

ENJOY THE LITTLE DETAILS

Warm wood grain, bright landscapes, spinning blades, and flying chips make each cleared patch feel rewarding. Simple controls keep the focus on cutting, collecting, and finding your next path.

From the first narrow trail to a wide-open clearing, there is always another satisfying slice ahead.

description:
In Endless Assault you hold a single lane against skeletons, and they keep coming until you fall. Drag left and right to aim. Your soldier fires on its own. Shoot a gate open and another soldier joins you. It's a wave shooter with no last wave, so the only goal is getting further than last time.

HOW A RUN GOES

Skeletons walk toward you in packs. Kill them before they get close, because once one reaches the front it stops and starts hitting you, and it doesn't matter which side of the lane you've moved to.

At least every other wave brings a gate with a number on it. That's how many hits it takes. Break it and you get one more soldier, up to a squad of 12. Once the squad is full, a gate gives you Overdrive instead: 8 seconds of faster fire and a bit of health.

Most waves also send a debuff your way. Shoot it down and you get 5 HP back. Let it reach you and it takes 30% of your max health and halves your squad's fire rate for 4 seconds, which is usually when things go wrong.

UPGRADES

About once a minute the game pauses and you pick an upgrade, usually out of three.

• Firepower, more damage for every soldier

• Rapid Fire makes the whole squad shoot 25% faster

• Body Armor: +40 max health, and enemy hits do a quarter less

• Squad Leader gives you two soldiers right away and room for two more (take it twice and the squad tops out at 16)

• Piercing Rounds, so a bullet carries on into the next skeleton

Each one has a cap. You can't stack Firepower forever, so sooner or later the build has to get wider.

CHAPTERS

Every 10 waves is a chapter with the same mix: big swarms, waves of a few oversized skeletons with a lot of health, a rush where the packs come close together, a short breather, and a finale at the end. Clear the finale and you're healed for half your max health, which you'll need. Health also comes back slowly on its own, and faster once nothing has hit you for two seconds.

Your best wave is saved and shown on the menu, so there's always a number to beat.

WHAT IT ISN'T

It's a wave shooter, not a campaign. There's no story, no base building, no levels to finish and no energy timer. Just the lane and as many waves as you can take. If you want a survival shooter you can play for five minutes on the bus and put down again, that's what I was going for.

PRICE, ADS AND DATA

Endless Assault is a free wave shooter. There are no ads and nothing to buy. It plays fully offline, so a flight or a dead zone on the train is fine. It doesn't collect anything about you. Your best wave is stored on your phone and nowhere else. You can pause at any point.

If a wave feels unfair or something breaks, email filipnordquist@protonmail.com and tell me which wave it was.

description:
You wake up on the top floor of an office skyscraper as a massive earthquake tears the building apart. Floor by floor, the tower is collapsing — and the only way out is DOWN. Race from the very top to the ground and escape before the structure caves in, the debris crushes you, or the fall ends your run. A first-person survival horror race against time where every second counts.

⚠️ SURVIVE THE COLLAPSE

Every aftershock shatters columns, floors and stairwells. Damage stacks up: the higher you are, the harder it shakes, so the building crumbles from the top down and cuts off the way back. Move fast — or get buried.

🏢 A NEW BUILDING EVERY RUN

The skyscraper is procedurally generated. Every escape drops you into a fresh layout of rooms, corridors and stairs built from a unique seed. No two runs are ever the same — a true roguelike survival experience with endless replay value.

🔦 INTO THE DARK

On night levels only the lights on your current floor are lit. Grab a flashlight for a narrow beam that cuts the darkness — but the battery drains fast, and losing your light mid-collapse can be fatal.

❤️ HEALTH & DANGER

Falls, flying debris and the shaking all hurt. Jump off an open edge above the first floor and it's instant death. At low health the screen darkens at the edges — find medkits and flashlights scattered across the floors before it's too late.

🪜 FIND THE WAY DOWN

Stairwells always lead toward the exit, and a vertical floor gauge shows how high you are and how far you still have to fall. Read the risks, keep your nerve, and get out.

🎮 FEATURES

- First-person survival horror escape

- Procedurally generated collapsing skyscraper

- 20 levels of rising difficulty — from small daytime offices to towering night high-rises

- Roguelike replayability — a new seed every run

- Flashlight, medkits and item pickups

description:
The sun has died. You are a Luminar: your light is your ammunition, your life, and your only way of seeing. Enter, eliminate the threats, activate the circles, and cross the extraction door before the darkness engulfs you.

NEW IN 1.6: CREATURES AND GRENADES

Fourteen newly sculpted and textured creatures with articulated hands and unique attack patterns: claw swipes, thrusts, hammer blows, and hooks. The demon alternates its claws with a tail whip. You can see them prepare their attack and dodge it with a Step. Upon landing, they collapse and are consumed by embers.

Grenades fly in an arc toward their target and explode on contact with a creature, a wall, or the ground. The blast damages nearby enemies and knocks back and stuns survivors (except bosses) with fire, smoke, and dust effects.

A 500-LEVEL CAMPAIGN

• 50 named chapters, from the evacuation tunnels to the dawn of Ground Zero.

• Ten environments: ship, cloister, crypt, bell tower, choir, laboratory, subway, foundry, district, and nest, each with environmental hazards.

• Elimination missions, activation circles, defense, and time trials. The game tells you what's missing and highlights it.

• Bosses from level 10 and the demon from level 201.

• Replay levels to improve your medals without losing progress.

YOUR LIGHT, YOUR ABILITIES

• Fire, Step, and Track. Your special action uses Spear; while you have grenades, switch to an explosive throw.

• Grenades earned are saved between games until you use them.

• Choose an upgrade at each altar: damage, speed, recovery in pits, or shield-piercing shots.

• Combos, style rank, relics, and score per level.

COME BACK EVERY DAY

• Daily reward with a seven-day streak: Collect up to five grenades on the seventh day and choose whether to double the reward.

• If you fall, see how close you were and which medal you need for the next weapon color.

• Weapon colors and firing effects unlocked with medals.

MOBILE DESIGNED

• Large floating joystick that appears where your thumb rests.

• Menus optimized for phones and tablets.

• No auto-ads in levels 1-3; after that, their frequency is limited per session.

OPTIONAL, NEVER REQUIRED

You can play all 500 levels for free. The Golden Pass is a monthly subscription with automatic renewal: it removes in-game ads and offers one full-health revive per game, unlimited grenades while active, the permanent Golden weapon after the first confirmed payment, and exclusive colors with a current pass.

The Ad-Free In-Game monthly subscription removes ads between levels and allows two revives per level without video. Bonus grenades and other optional rewards still use ad-supported gameplay. With the Golden Pass active, your saved grenades are not consumed.

Ad-supported gameplay is optional: revives, altar upgrades, a three-pack of grenades, or double your daily reward.

Zero Zone requires an internet connection and contains ads.

How far will your light reach?

description:
Defend the frozen outpost in Waddlewardens!

Enemy penguins are marching in waves, and your icy fortress is the last line of defense. Aim carefully, fire at the right moment, use powerful skills, and protect your base from the incoming penguin army!

Waddlewardens is a fun and fast-paced mobile defense game that combines action, shooting, and castle defense gameplay. Enemies approach from the left side of the battlefield, while your fortress stands on the right. Your mission is to stop every wave before the enemies reach your base and destroy it.

Each wave brings more danger. Some enemies move quickly, some take more damage, and some can overwhelm your defense if you are not prepared. Use your weapon wisely, manage your ammo, and activate special abilities at the perfect time to survive.

Earn coins by defeating enemies and use them to improve your defense. Upgrade your firepower, strengthen your base, and prepare for tougher battles. Bombs can deal heavy damage to groups of enemies, while special skills can slow down or stop enemies when your fortress is in danger.

Game Features:

Wave-based penguin defense gameplay

Fast and simple action shooting mechanics

Defend your icy fortress from enemy penguins

Use weapons, bombs, and special abilities

Increasing difficulty with each level

Earn coins and improve your defense

Fun arctic battlefield atmosphere

Easy-to-learn mobile controls

Cute but battle-ready penguin characters

A mix of action, strategy, and defense gameplay

How to Play

Enemy penguins enter the battlefield and move toward your frozen base. Tap the fire button to shoot, use bombs to damage groups of enemies, and activate special skills when the situation becomes dangerous.

Clear all enemy waves to win the level. But be careful — if your base health reaches zero, the defense fails. To succeed, you need more than fast shooting. Choose the right targets, save your abilities for critical moments, and keep your fortress standing until the final wave.

Protect the Ice Kingdom

Waddlewardens invites you to a frozen battlefield full of action, strategy, and penguin-powered defense. Stop the enemy waves, protect your fortress, and become the true guardian of the ice outpost.

Join the battle now and defend your frozen base!

Shadow Hunter is an offline, top-down stealth action game. Watch guard patrols, stay out of flashlight beams and use distractions to complete your mission and reach the exit.

WATCH, DISTRACT AND ESCAPE

Read the patrol routes before you move. Hide in bushes, travel through vents and choose when to strike or dash away. Use lures, smoke bombs and traps to create an opening, with simple touch controls that keep the focus on your tactics.

60 LEVELS ACROSS SIX CHAPTERS

CHOOSE YOUR HUNTER AND GEAR

Find your play style with 12 hunters and 17 weapons. Unlock new gadgets as you progress, develop your hideout facilities and improve your abilities.

MORE WAYS TO TEST YOUR TACTICS

Take on daily challenges, missions, achievements and Boss Rush. The weekly Blackout challenge adds dark rooms and more patrols, with gems and boosters to earn. Challenge rankings use AI rivals, clearly identified in the game.

OFFLINE PLAY AND 28 LANGUAGES

Play the campaign without an account or an internet connection. Progress is saved on your current device. Choose from 28 languages in Settings, including English, Korean, Hindi and Bangla, or follow your device language.

description:
The king will fall. His fortune won't.

King Dies Rich is a pixel-art siege roguelite about holding the throne against the undead, finding powerful loot, and turning every defeat into a stronger kingdom.

Your king stays on his throne as enemies close in from every side. Slide a finger to guide the attack circle while he strikes automatically. Pick the most dangerous targets, break up the horde, and survive the next boss. Choose drag or direct touch aiming to suit your play style.

SEVEN SCHOOLS OF POWER

Shape your build with Fire, Frost, Poison, Lightning, Guard, Blades, and Spirits. Burn the undead, freeze a crowd, unleash chain lightning, or surround the throne with blades and spirit archers. LOOT, EQUIP, REFORGE

Collect gear with different bonuses and school effects. Compare finds, equip legendary items, upgrade your favorites, and reforge their properties. Set gems in the throne and combine them into stronger gems as your Kingdom develops.

BUILD A LASTING KINGDOM

Spend the gold you earn on the Arsenal, Citadel, Treasury, Forge, and Mines. Buildings provide lasting upgrades and unlock more ways to improve your king. Your gold, gear, gems, and Kingdom progress stay with you when a siege ends, even if the king falls.

DEEPER HALLS, DEADLIER BOSSES

Battle through the Throne Hall, Crypt, and Chapel. Defeat each hall's boss to open the next, then face tougher enemies in the next circle. Discover the Bone Giant, the Maned and Chained Ghouls, and the Mourner. Fill your Bestiary as you learn what each enemy can do.

PLAY OFFLINE

Enjoy the game on phones and tablets in landscape, with touch controls, adjustable sound, and optional vibration. No internet connection is needed to play. No ads. No account required.

Hold a little longer. Find a better crown. Die rich.

description:
Hell Escape suits players who want short action runs with steady character growth and direct combat. The game places you in changing versions of hell, where each run pushes you through dangerous paths and enemy waves. As a result, the focus stays on moving forward, surviving pressure, and improving your fighter between attempts. Players looking for the Hell Escape APK can expect a mobile game built around quick sessions, repeated upgrades, and boss encounters.


Main Hell Escape Features

Timeline based hell worlds

Hell Escape sends you through underworld areas shaped by different eras, including ancient, medieval, and futuristic settings. Each world changes the look of the escape route and brings different enemies into your path. Because the stages keep shifting in theme, the game gives each run a clear sense of movement through time while staying focused on action.

Fast running and combat

You control a character who keeps pushing forward while fighting enemies along the route. Hell Escape uses hack and slash action, dashing, and attack skills to keep battles active during each stage. Instead of stopping for long menus during combat, you react quickly, clear enemies, and keep moving toward the next threat.

Character growth between runs

Hell Escape includes action RPG progression, so your character can become stronger over time. You can upgrade stats, unlock abilities, and evolve into stronger forms as you continue playing. This structure is important for players who enjoy games where repeated attempts still help long term progress.

Simple controls with a higher challenge

You can understand the basic controls quickly, which makes Hell Escape Android gameplay suitable for short phone sessions. However, later stages still require timing, movement, and better upgrade choices. This balance means the game is easy to start, but surviving harder runs depends on how well you handle enemies and resources.

Boss battles that block progress

Hell Escape places powerful guardians at key points in the escape route. These bosses are not only stronger enemies, because they also require you to notice attack patterns and avoid damage at the right time. After several runs, learning these fights becomes part of the normal progress cycle.


Hell Escape Progression Notes

Hell Escape is built around repeated upgrades, so progress often depends on how you spend resources after each run. Players who enjoy upgrade based action games may find this structure clear and familiar. At the same time, it is useful to pay attention before confirming upgrades or weapon changes, because player feedback mentions that some upgrade behavior can feel confusing.

When building your character, focus first on upgrades that help survival and damage during normal stages. Then, as bosses become harder, adjust your choices toward skills or weapons that help you stay alive longer. This approach keeps progression practical instead of spreading resources across every option too early.


Monetization in Hell Escape

Hell Escape is a mobile game from Rollic Games, and player feedback points to ads, energy wait times, and purchase prompts as part of the experience. These elements may appear more often after later stages, so users should consider their tolerance for interruptions before choosing to download Hell Escape. This does not change the core action gameplay, but it can affect the pace of longer play sessions.

If you prefer short sessions, the game structure may still fit well because each run is quick. However, if you plan to play for a long time in one sitting, waiting systems and ad breaks may slow your progress. Knowing this before installation helps set a realistic expectation for how the game feels over time.


How to Play Hell Escape on Android

Hell Escape starts with simple movement and attack rules, then adds pressure through enemy groups, upgrades, and boss fights. After installing the Hell Escape latest version, you can follow a steady play pattern that supports progress across repeated runs.

  1. Open Hell Escape and begin a run from the starting area, then watch the path ahead so you can react to enemies and obstacles early.
  2. Move through the stage while attacking demons in your way, and use dash or skills when enemy groups become too dense.
  3. Collect available rewards during the run, then continue pushing forward until you reach tougher enemy waves or a boss gate.
  4. After the run ends, review your upgrade options and choose stats, abilities, or weapon improvements that match the problem you faced.
  5. Start the next run with your improved character, then use what you learned from earlier stages to survive longer and move closer to escape.


Start Playing Hell Escape

Hell Escape combines running action, hack and slash combat, character upgrades, and boss battles in short mobile stages. If this style matches your preference, the Hell Escape download gives you a direct way to try its escape focused gameplay on Android.

🕹 Relive the golden age of the arcade! Classic Arcade Games brings 60+ retro 90s arcade games to your phone: beat 'em ups, fighting games, run-and-gun shooters, shoot 'em ups, platformers and puzzle games, all in one app.

Download a game once and play it offline, anytime, anywhere. No Wi-Fi needed on the bus, plane or couch.

👊 60+ ARCADE CLASSICS

• Beat 'em up: team up and clean the streets, stage after stage

• Fighting games: one-on-one battles with classic combos

• Run and gun & shoot 'em up: fast retro shooting action

• Platformers and puzzle games for a quick round

• New retro games added regularly

🎮 PLAY YOUR WAY

• Virtual joystick and arcade buttons made for touch screens

• Customize the controls: drag every button where you want it and save your layout

• Gamepad and controller support for the real arcade feel

• Tilt controls on supported games

• 2-player mode on supported games

💾 NEVER LOSE YOUR PROGRESS

• Save state and load state at any moment

• Pick up exactly where you left off

📴 OFFLINE ARCADE GAMES

• Download once, play offline forever

• Smooth play on Android phones and tablets

⭐ GO PREMIUM (OPTIONAL)

All games are free to play with ads. Premium removes every ad, including in-game ads, with instant play and instant downloads. Or watch one short video and play 30 minutes without ads.

Insert coin, press Start and relive the 90s arcade. Download Classic Arcade Games now!
